en: Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a village in a hilly, forested landscape. Timber‑framed houses are scattered on the hillside, and in the foreground stands a large multi‑storey building with decorative gables and a tower-like central section identified as a hotel. Conifer and deciduous trees surround the buildings. The place name and region are printed at the top in red text, and the hotel name appears at the bottom right.
